ordering: numerical Cullen procedure order; cumulative exposed primary/context bodies excluded
A_qualification: Every certificate must cite source spans and frozen production/resource/protocol identifiers. Primitive operation-name overlap alone does not establish construction closure.
B_selection: Earliest four remaining after A and its necessary context bodies are locked. No known-grammar or family replacement filter.
insufficient_A: INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_MATERIAL; no new experiment or replacement by exposed targets
shared_context: Already developed shared parameters/method context may recur; disclose shared dependence. A newly read target/context body is exposed and cannot subsequently be another fresh primary.
selection_after: Accepted development gate and complete behavior freeze
parser_access_before_lock: forbidden: no probing, parse, execute or parser-output review
batch_lock: All eight primary/context packets, references and fixed atom registrations before any first-run parser invocation
first_attempt: Exclusive experiment journal, source identity claim and outputs, including errors/timeouts; never repair then rename as first
interpretation: Conditional source profiles and task initial selectors declared before lock; no derived intermediate inputs
score_revision_after_first: May document a grader defect but cannot use revised score to cross continuation gate
